cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong is supported by a position-2 sulfate chassis reinforced by a second anionic sulfonate route and active/reset architecture, even after betaine and conditioning counter-signals.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Cocamidopropyl Betaine at position 4 and silicone/polymer deposition routes soften the chassis but do not erase the second anionic route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate conditioning fits the silicone gum, cationic guar, dimethicone and refatting ester system, but the active strong-cleansing chassis keeps the care effect bounded.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Multiple silicone/polymer routes prevent a low conditioning call.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate weight potential is the cleanest whole-formula band: persistent silicone/polymer routes can accumulate, but strong anionic reset prevents a high-weight conclusion.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Sodium Laureth Sulfate at position 2 plus TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate at position 16 gives strong reset capacity.

weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Silicone gum, dimethicone and cationic guar make noticeable residue plausible, while the strong surfactant chassis keeps it bounded.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: High would ignore the strong reset route; low would ignore several persistent deposition signals.

focusPrimary.rationale: Scalp active is formula-derived because Piroctone Olamine is present at position 10 and is the v1.4 recognized anti-dandruff active.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: The formula also carries silicone/polymer care routes, but they are secondary to the recognized active route.

focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is kept because the formula has conditioning routes but no blind-safe distinct second role independent of the scalp-active route.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: The silicone/polymer system could later support a care secondary if visible positioning separates it.

usageRole.rationale: Treatment is formula-derived because the complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine, a recognized anti-dandruff active under v1.4.
usageRole.counterSignal: Strong cleansing alone would not create treatment use, but the recognized active does.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted is provisional but supported by the recognized scalp-active route plus later niacinamide and panthenol comfort clues.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Parfum at position 6 and strong cleansing are meaningful comfort counter-signals.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported is mechanical: Piroctone Olamine appears in the complete INCI at position 10.
dandruffSupport.counterSignal: No counter-signal changes the mechanical rule once Piroctone Olamine is present in a complete INCI.
